subject: On-prem wiring & compliance playback — Mediframe
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Mendez <alyssa@mediframe.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediframe.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: On-prem wiring & compliance playback — Mediframe

Hi Alyssa / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick playback from our side and a concise next-steps list so we keep momentum. Please flag anything I misunderstood.

High-level goals you described
- Keep inference traffic strictly within Mediframe-managed VLANs; no egress to public internet for inference payloads.
- Data residency: PHI processing must remain in the US region and meet your retention policies (90 days KV-cache, 365 days audit logs).
- Regulatory driver: state-level healthcare regulator wants strong evidence of network isolation and key-management controls. You mentioned the legal team will require a network diagram and a SOC2 attestation.

Primary technical constraints (what you called out)
- Air-gapped inference appliance preferred for pilot nodes — isolated subnet behind a hardware firewall.
- No outbound connections from the inference VMs except to a pre-approved management IP range (for metrics and OS patching).
- Allowlist for egress to our management plane (if we run a private control-plane proxy) is limited to specific IPs; you need an option where the control plane is fully customer-hosted.

What Redwood can commit to for the pilot
- Private deployment (on-prem) with customer-managed control plane option.
- Provide the network wiring sketch and a short evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, sample audit log format) — attached.
- Support a short technical review with our infra engineer (Jordan) next week to confirm firewall rules and NAT exceptions.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Mediframe to share the internal network diagram (layer 3 addressing + firewall egress rules) — Alyssa/Tom
2) Redwood to deliver a one-page wiring diagram and evidence zip (attached) — Ben (today)
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (Jordan + Mediframe infra) — propose Wed 11/11 or Thu 11/12, 10–11am PT — Jordan/Laura to confirm
4) Legal to list any extra attestation items — Mediframe legal (Alyssa to loop them in)

Attachments: mediframe-network-wiring-sketch.pdf, redwood-evidence-summary.zip

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once Jordan confirms availability.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alyssa Mendez <alyssa@mediframe.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediframe.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem wiring & compliance playback — Mediframe

Ben — thanks for the summary and for sending the attachments. Confirmation / clarifications: 

- Correct on goals and constraints. Legal needs a wiring diagram plus a short statement on key management options (KMS/HSM integration) and whether private control plane mode removes the need for outbound API calls from our VPC.
- For the pilot we want two inference nodes initially in our data center (not cloud) behind a dedicated firewall with no internet egress except to our monitoring appliance.
- Audit log retention requirement: immutable logs for 12 months, searchable export on demand. The 365-day note you listed was a suggestion — legal will confirm exact retention requirement.

I attached the SOC2 attestation they requested (Mediframe-SOC2-Attestation.pdf).

We are good to do the technical deep dive on Wed 11/11 10am PT — Jordan, does that work for you? If so, please send a calendar invite and an agenda (30 minutes technical, 15 minutes for operational/next steps).

Best,
Alyssa
Director of IT Operations | Mediframe Health
alyssa@mediframe.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Attachment: Mediframe-SOC2-Attestation.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem wiring & compliance playback — Mediframe

Thanks — I’ll take the tech lead on the deep dive. Short agenda I propose:
- 10m: network topology review (Mediframe diagram)
- 10m: control-plane options (customer-hosted proxy vs. fully isolated)
- 10m: key management options and HSM integration patterns
- 15m: firewall rules and port list (what Redwood needs to function) + open questions

Two asks for Alyssa / Tom before the call so we can be efficient:
1) Share the L3 addressing and current firewall policy for the subnet hosting the inference nodes (screenshot or exported rule list).
2) Confirm whether you have a corporate HSM (Y/N) and the vendor (Thales/AWS KMS/Onprem HSM).

I’ll draft a minimal port list and a suggested deny-by-default rule set and include it in the invite.

—Jordan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
